Name: Earthy Recolour for Stardew Valley Expanded
Author: risrain
Description:
[size=3]This is an environment-only set of edits for Stardew Valley Expanded, to make them match DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour. I put this together because I personally use this environment recolor and SVE, and it didn't appear that anyone else had made a compatibility mod for the two of them yet. **It does not include anything from Earthy Interiors or Interface, nor does it edit the buildings - and I will not be adding them.** But [url=www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42535]SeaSea[/url] DID actually release one about a month ago! I took too long, haha. Regardless, I am still uploading this, as it varies a bit from theirs. :)[/size]

[size=3]Other than the snow, grass, dirt and such that had direct matches from Earthy Recolour, I also recolored:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]The Castle Village & Iridium Quarry sand - Castle Village was made to match the beach sand (not exact copies - used a gradient layer to approximate it as best I could) and the Iridium Quarry is a lightened desert sand.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]The crops that grow around villager's houses were edited to match Cometkins' Better Crops (config option)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]The normal (not refurb) Shearwater Bridge is made to match the town cobbles for each season[/size][/*]
[*]The new trees from 1.15 (Wild: Fir, Birch; Fruit: Pear, Nectarine, Persimmon, Money) have been given Earthy-matching recolors. Can be disabled via config in case you use something like Simple Foliage for SVE[/*]
[*]The crafted wood and hardwood fences match the Earthy Recolour static fences (changes seasonally)[/*]
[*]The small hardwood fence matches the Earthy Recolour static fence (not seasonal) and the Hedge Fence has seasonal Earthy leaves and matching gate.[/*]
[*]The tree and grass in the Enchanted Grove warp area (config option)[/*]
[*]Spent a stupid amount of time making sure the Sakura Vineyard Tilesheet all matched Earthy colors, even though it's only used for one very specific 14-heart event 😅[/*]
[*]The optional flowering vines[/*]
[*]The "Mother Starfruit" tree that shows up in Apple's Room[/*]
[*]Small things like: outdoor ladder, boat, benches, bones, villager shipping bins, craftable versions of the boulders, plants, mushrooms, etc.[/*]
[/list]
While it is not required, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] will make it much easier to manage the various config options. 

The only visual mods used in the screenshots are:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earth Recolour[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface 2.0[/url] + [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20754]1.6 Fix[/url]

[size=3][b][u]Credits:[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko]DaisyNiko[/url] & the "Earthy" environment mods, namely: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21545]Earthy Recolour Edit Layers[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Better Crops/Foraging/etc assets from [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/cometkins/mods?gameId=1303]Cometkins[/url]﻿ [/size][/*]
[/list]
